positive_examples: T3:009 retains the financial-instrument definition, classification table and the ordinary-purchase versus difference-settlement boundary.
T3:011 retains both recognition bases with all four dates and every journal-entry line.
T3:013-T3:014 converts the two derecognition diagrams into component lists, control-transfer tests and whole-asset conclusions.

negative_or_boundary_examples: T3:007 initially omitted six explicit study-reference lines; the pilot correction restored them and refreshed S01 hashes.
T3:016 preserves that a buyback right or bankruptcy invalidation prevents control transfer.
T3:017 preserves that a restriction can still permit transfer when sale to many other third parties remains possible.
T3:018 preserves that the benefit-enjoyment test applies to security holders when the transferee is a special-purpose company.
T3:019 preserves that same-price trading-purpose securities are not automatically a cross transaction.
T3:030 preserves direct deduction as an exception for bankruptcy/reorganization claims, not as the general allowance treatment.
